english.title: Trader fail to draw withdrawal provisions to attention of consumer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader, failed, before entering into a regulated contract, to draw the attention of a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..).to the

(A)_[right of withdrawal under]_
(B)_[length of the withdrawal period of]_
(C)_[the prohibition on advance consideration during the withdrawal period of]_

the contract
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1) and (4) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
